meta.title: Modern Luxury Bedroom 1 (4.9m x 4.0m) - King Bed, TV Wall and Lounge Nook

physical_properties.bed: king size (approx. 1.83m x 2.03m mattress) upholstered bed with tall channel-tufted ivory boucle headboard mounted on a freestanding walnut-panelled headboard wall, slim low-profile frame, bed floating in the middle of the room
physical_properties.bedding: crisp white sateen sheets, champagne silk-look duvet folded back at the foot, layered euro shams and two lumbar pillows in taupe velvet, chunky knit throw draped at an angle
physical_properties.nightstand: two walnut veneer nightstands, about 0.5m wide each, with fluted drawer fronts, brushed brass pulls and travertine tops
physical_properties.lamp: sculptural ceramic table lamp with pleated linen shade, switched off
physical_properties.finish: rich mix of matte, velvet, boucle and brushed metal textures

midground.notes: stack of two coffee-table books, small brass tray with a glass carafe, a bud vase with a single white ranunculus, a slim gold alarm clock
sculptural taupe boucle lounge chair, round travertine side table with a cup of coffee and an open book, slim brass arc floor lamp

background.notes: freestanding walnut-panelled half-height wall with integrated warm LED strip along the top edge (off), glimpse of the doorway to the ensuite visible past one end
small blown-glass pendants on brass rods, off
65 inch slim TV, screen off, on fluted walnut panelling above a floating walnut TV unit with soft LED glow underneath
2.3m wide x 1.54m high window with a 0.56m sill, ceiling-hung sheer ivory curtains and greige linen drapes pulled open, soft view of greenery outside; not a door, no balcony

surface.details: wide-plank light oak floor with a plush cream wool rug under the bed

background.texture: limewash plaster wall in warm greige

palette.notes: ivory, greige and taupe base with champagne brass, walnut and a touch of deep slate

atmosphere.mood: serene, elegant, boutique-hotel calm on a fresh morning

camera.focus_point: whole room: king bed in the foreground and center, TV wall on the right, lounge chair and south window on the left
camera.position: standing just inside the entry door in the north-east corner, looking diagonally south-west across the room toward the corner where the TV wall meets the south window

lighting.key_light_source: morning sunlight through the 2.3m wide south window, filtered by sheer curtains
lighting.notes: soft sunbeams falling across the bedding, gentle shadows, no artificial lights on

style.rendering: photorealistic interior photography, architectural digest editorial quality
style.scale_notes: ceiling is a standard 2.4m, keep proportions realistic: TV unit 0.35m off the floor, TV centre at 1.1m, headboard wall 1.2m, window head at 2.1m

room_layout.bed_wall: king bed aligned on the centre line of the 0.9m walkway between the robes (about 2.85m from the north wall, 0.4m south of the room centre), headboard on the east side facing west toward the TV
room_layout.window_wall: south wall (4.0m): one window 2.3m wide x 1.54m high, sill about 0.56m above the floor and head at about 2.1m, centred on the wall (0.85m of solid wall each side); dressed with a ceiling-mounted track running wider than the window, sheer ivory curtains and greige linen drapes pulled open, so the window reads larger; to the bed's left as you lie in it
room_layout.entry_door: 0.9m wide door in the east wall at the north-east corner, coming in from the hallway, hinged at the north end and swinging into the room to rest against the north wall; its swing stays clear of the headboard wall and nightstand
room_layout.ensuite_opening: 0.9m wide opening in the east wall between the two walk-in robes, leading to the ensuite; hidden behind the freestanding headboard wall
room_layout.clearances: east-west across 4.0m: 0.7m walkway + 0.1m headboard wall + about 2.15m king bed + about 0.75m walkway + 0.3m TV unit; north-south along 4.9m: bed centred at about 2.85m from the north wall, about 1.9m between the north side of the bed and the north wall, about 1.1m between the south side of the bed and the south glass doors
room_layout.headboard_feature_wall: freestanding headboard wall 1.2m high, 0.1m thick and about 2.9m long (bed plus two nightstands), set 0.7m west of the east wall, centred on the robe walkway so it screens it from the bedroom; about 1.4m clear at the north end (entry door side) and 0.6m at the south end
room_layout.opposite_wall: the long left wall facing the foot of the bed: floating TV wall with a 65 inch TV centered on the bed

tv_wall.tv: 65 inch ultra-slim TV (approx. 1.45m wide x 0.83m tall), flush wall-mounted and centred on the bed, screen center about 1.1m above the floor for viewing from bed, screen off showing a dark glossy surface
tv_wall.backdrop: floor-to-ceiling (2.4m) vertical fluted walnut panelling about 2.0m wide behind the TV, centred on the bed, with a soft warm LED wash from above
tv_wall.floating_unit: wall-hung walnut TV module about 1.8m wide, 0.3m deep and 0.3m high, centred on the bed (not the wall), floating about 0.35m above the floor with hidden LED glow underneath, push-to-open fronts, travertine top styled with a small sculpture and a low ceramic bowl

room_layout.lounge_nook: south-west corner, between the south end of the TV unit and the south window, beside the foot of the bed: sculptural taupe boucle lounge chair angled toward the view, round travertine side table, slim brass floor lamp, small round wool rug; the chair sits partly in front of the west end of the window, below sill height for its seat, catching the daylight
room_layout.orientation: room runs north-south; west wall (TV wall) 4.9m long, north and south walls 4.0m and solid apart from the south glazing; east side has the entry door (north end), the robes and the ensuite opening
